name: bertos-brain-bridge
description: Self-contained MCP bridge that exposes the bertosV2 'brain' (Council / Deep Build / Auto / build / projects / providers) to the BertOS body. Vendored into the body image so the Dockerized body can spawn it without mounting the brain repo. Source of truth: ~/Documents/bertosV2/scripts/brain-mcp-server.mjs — keep in sync (see README.md).
